objective: Implement deterministic breadth-first clarification waves with adaptive depth, contradiction detection, coverage measurement, and mandatory 0.99 closure.
included: Typed explore, challenge, clarify, and validate strategy orchestration.
Deterministic question waves and explicit closure or clarification outcomes.
excluded: Allowing a strategy or model to approve its own requirements or bypass RequirementsGate.
deliverables: Adaptive interview orchestrator, closure evaluator, and regression fixtures.
verificationMethod: Run clear, ambiguous, contradictory, large-scope, continuation, and replay fixtures through exact question-wave and closure evaluation.
successCriteria: Every run either reaches evidence-backed 0.99 closure and emits a gate candidate or returns explicit unresolved questions without silent assumptions.

objective: Provide replaceable typed requirements strategies inspired by BMAD, GSD, and Superpowers plus bounded OpenSpec and Spec Kit bindings.
included: Provider-neutral strategy contracts and deterministic composition rules.
Strategy provenance, output normalization, and adversarial requirement-quality fixtures.
excluded: Importing another framework's workflow authority or exposing model-selected strategies.
deliverables: Conformant strategy library and bounded adapter bindings.

dependencyHints.rationale: Strategies plug into the Core-owned interview and closure protocol.

verificationMethod: Run each strategy against the same incomplete goal and prove typed output, deterministic normalization, provenance, and mandatory closure enforcement.
successCriteria: Strategies can be swapped or composed without changing Core routing, Gate authority, or canonical requirements artifacts.

objective: Implement explicit, project-local, version-pinned provider acquisition and availability checks owned by the host.
included: Checksum, license, version, permission, and telemetry-policy verification.
Deterministic unavailable and mismatch failures with no silent upgrade or substitution.
excluded: Adapter-owned downloads, global installs, or implicit network access.
deliverables: Pinned provider acquisition and availability manager.
verificationMethod: Exercise approved acquisition, offline use, missing tool, checksum mismatch, version drift, license denial, and attempted adapter download fixtures.
successCriteria: Only explicitly approved, checksum-pinned project-local tools execute and all unavailable states fail closed with stable diagnostics.

objective: Capture immutable raw local execution receipts and digest-bound redacted Git views for every bounded provider effect.
included: Command fingerprints, exact stdout and stderr bytes, exit code, duration, tool version, grants, and redaction mapping.
Receipt persistence and replay verification.
excluded: Exporting source, logs, or telemetry to a hosted service by default.
deliverables: Execution receipt recorder and redaction verifier.
verificationMethod: Capture success, failure, timeout, binary output, secret-redaction, and byte-identical replay fixtures.
successCriteria: Every bounded effect has immutable local provenance and every redacted view is verifiably bound to retained raw bytes.

objective: Record non-authoritative local performance metrics from host-observed lifecycle activity without inventing unavailable values.
included: Cycle duration, wait time, retries, test time, cache hits, changed files, receipts, and available token or tool usage.
Provenance and explicit unavailable dispositions.
excluded: Network telemetry export, ranking engineers, or changing Gate outcomes from metrics alone.
deliverables: Local performance metrics recorder and report projection.

dependencyHints.rationale: Metrics consume exact host-observed receipt timing and effect identities.

verificationMethod: Run deterministic metric aggregation with complete, partial, unavailable, replayed, retried, and cached observations.
successCriteria: Every reported metric has exact provenance or an explicit unavailable disposition and cannot mutate authoritative workflow state.

objective: Expose compact read-only provenance, coverage, evidence, impact, and orphan queries over approved TraceabilityGraph state.
included: Deterministic bounded paths, compact defaults, pagination, and MCP-compatible read-only operations.
Why, covered-by, impact, and missing-evidence query families.
excluded: Graph mutation, arbitrary relationship creation, or treating query output as Gate approval.
deliverables: Read-only trace query service and compact report mode.
verificationMethod: Query fixed graph fixtures for provenance, impact, coverage, orphan, missing-evidence, pagination, authorization, and byte-identical replay cases.
successCriteria: Users can answer lifecycle provenance questions compactly without mutating or overstating graph authority.

objective: Implement two-phase Git sealing that binds an implementation commit to a later evidence commit without self-reference.
included: Implementation seal, evidence seal, ancestry checks, dirty-tree checks, and exact digest bindings.
Tamper, replay, wrong-parent, and modified-evidence fixtures.
excluded: Signing releases, pushing branches, or bypassing BusinessAcceptance authority.
deliverables: Two-phase Git evidence seal coordinator and verifier.

dependencyHints.rationale: The evidence commit seals the complete immutable receipt set.

verificationMethod: Create temporary repositories and verify valid two-phase seals plus self-reference, wrong-parent, dirty-tree, stale, and tampered-evidence failures.
successCriteria: The evidence seal proves exact implementation ancestry and evidence bytes without embedding either commit's identity in itself.

objective: Execute real version-pinned OpenSpec and Spec Kit requirements capabilities through bounded adapters with strict validation and archival.
included: Live CLI availability, invocation, native artifact archival, strict provider validation, canonical normalization, and receipts.
Provider-missing, version-mismatch, malformed-output, and non-zero-exit fixtures.
excluded: Running either provider's entire workflow as one DevRelay module or allowing provider-owned progression.
deliverables: Live OpenSpec and Spec Kit adapter implementations with conformance evidence.

dependencyHints.rationale: Live providers execute only after host-owned version and checksum resolution.
Every live provider effect must emit an immutable receipt.

verificationMethod: Run pinned live OpenSpec and Spec Kit smoke and conformance cases, archive native outputs, normalize them, and compare deterministic reruns.
successCriteria: Both providers produce validated canonical artifacts with exact live receipts, while missing or drifting tools fail explicitly.

objective: Execute current Structurizr validation, inspection, and export plus template-pinned MADR rendering and validation through bounded adapters.
included: Real C4 parse/export/normalize comparison, hierarchy and view checks, MADR schema and template checks, and receipts.
Malformed model, invalid C4 nesting, stale template, and provider-drift fixtures.
excluded: Using the legacy Structurizr CLI as the release target or allowing native artifacts to replace canonical architecture state.
deliverables: Current Structurizr and MADR live adapters with round-trip conformance tests.

dependencyHints.rationale: Architecture providers execute only after pinned toolchain resolution.
Every parser, exporter, and renderer effect must emit an immutable receipt.

verificationMethod: Run real Structurizr parse, inspect, export, normalize, and compare operations plus pinned MADR render and validate operations against positive and negative fixtures.
successCriteria: Canonical architecture and decisions round-trip through current live providers without hierarchy, view, relationship, or template drift.

objective: Ship four repository-scoped ChatGPT Desktop skills that guide users through released DevRelay operations without gaining Core authority.
included: devrelay-cycle, devrelay-godot-release, devrelay-plugin-conformance, and devrelay-trace-query guidance.
Windows paths, stop conditions, expected artifacts, and skill conformance fixtures.
excluded: A one-click Desktop plug-in, hidden provider installation, or skill-owned Gate decisions.
deliverables: Four repository-scoped Desktop skill packages and conformance evidence.

dependencyHints.rationale: The trace-query skill must bind to a released read-only query operation.
Cycle and release guidance must use the released sealing protocol.

verificationMethod: Validate skill structure and run each skill against a bounded Windows fixture to prove exact operation mapping, safe stop conditions, and no authority escalation.
successCriteria: A ChatGPT Desktop user can invoke all four guided workflows using released APIs while Core retains routing, validation, graph, and Gate authority.

objective: Add deterministic GDScript semantic discovery so Godot repositories produce architecture findings rather than file-only evidence.
included: Class, scene, signal, autoload, resource, dependency, and entry-point extraction with exact source locators.
Unsupported syntax, partial parse, ignore-rule, and confidence-disposition fixtures.
excluded: Executing game code during discovery or making Godot a Generic Core dependency.
deliverables: GDScript architecture discovery analyzer and fixtures.
verificationMethod: Run tracked Godot fixtures containing inheritance, signals, scenes, autoloads, resources, malformed syntax, and ignored files; compare exact semantic findings and confidence dispositions.
successCriteria: Supported GDScript repositories produce deterministic semantic architecture findings with exact file and line evidence, while gaps are explicit.

objective: Provide an optional least-privilege Godot AI MCP adapter for scene inspection, input simulation, screenshots, execution, and logs.
included: Explicit capability grants, dangerous-operation denial, screenshot and input receipts, timeouts, and project-root confinement.
Pinned live MCP compatibility evidence.
excluded: Default Godot dependency, unrestricted input injection, or implicit source transmission.
deliverables: Optional Godot AI MCP adapter and least-privilege policy fixtures.

dependencyHints.rationale: The MCP provider is pinned and resolved by the host.
Screenshots, simulated input, execution, and logs require exact receipts.

verificationMethod: Run allowed and denied MCP operations against a pinned Godot fixture and verify grants, paths, screenshots, inputs, logs, timeouts, and receipt bindings.
successCriteria: Only explicitly granted Godot operations run, every observable effect is receipted, and Generic Core remains domain-neutral.

objective: Add a GdUnit4 verification adapter that produces structured focused, full, scene, fuzz, flake, soak, JUnit, export, and smoke evidence.
included: Test discovery, runner invocation, JUnit normalization, flake and fuzz evidence, export verification, and raw receipts.
Pinned Godot and GdUnit4 version capture.
excluded: Treating raw console text alone as completion evidence or allowing the adapter to approve WorkItemVerification.
deliverables: GdUnit4 verification adapter and structured evidence normalizer.

dependencyHints.rationale: Godot and GdUnit4 versions must be resolved and pinned.
Runner output and exports require raw effect receipts.

verificationMethod: Run passing, failing, flaky, fuzz, scene, soak, export, and exported-build smoke fixtures and compare normalized JUnit and receipt evidence.
successCriteria: Godot verification produces structured, reproducible evidence sufficient for Core-owned verification decisions.

objective: Publish only Godot, Godot AI, and GdUnit4 version combinations backed by pinned live conformance and end-to-end evidence.
included: Compatibility registry schema, tested matrix, unsupported dispositions, and drift detection.
excluded: Claiming compatibility from documentation alone or silently widening version ranges.
deliverables: Evidence-backed Godot compatibility registry and matrix.

dependencyHints.rationale: Compatibility requires live MCP conformance.
Compatibility requires live structured test evidence.
Compatibility includes semantic discovery evidence.

verificationMethod: Run every declared version tuple in the Windows matrix, reject untested tuples, and verify deterministic registry generation from exact receipts.
successCriteria: Every published tuple points to exact passing evidence and every untested or drifting tuple is absent or explicitly unsupported.

objective: Make the human lifecycle report compact, Windows-safe, and explicit about operation and plug-in bindings.
included: Operation, configured adapter, maturity, outcome, duration, evidence, and next-action columns.
Compact default, detailed drill-down, and ASCII-safe or correctly encoded arrows.
excluded: Changing authoritative lifecycle state from report rendering or hiding failed evidence.
deliverables: Compact lifecycle report renderer with detailed binding drill-down.

dependencyHints.rationale: The report projects exact receipt provenance.
The report projects locally observed performance metrics.

verificationMethod: Render compact and detailed reports from success, failure, unavailable-plugin, replay, retry, and Windows Unicode fixtures; snapshot exact UTF-8 output.
successCriteria: A user can quickly see what ran, with which operation and provider, what passed, how long it took, and where exact evidence lives without encoding artifacts.

objective: Run the full released DevRelay lifecycle in ChatGPT Desktop on Windows against a separate minimal Godot software change and seal the resulting evidence.
included: Every applicable module and Gate, adaptive requirements waves, live providers, GDScript discovery, bounded implementation, structured verification, integration, system verification, BusinessAcceptance, trace queries, metrics, and two-phase sealing.
Exact plug-in maturity and unavailable dispositions.
excluded: Self-testing only inside DevRelay, hosted services, Sentry or PostHog activation, npm publication, or a one-click Desktop plug-in.
deliverables: Independent Windows Desktop Godot lifecycle run, compatibility evidence, and sealed acceptance record.

dependencyHints.rationale: The run must exercise adaptive strategy composition.
The run must use live specification providers.
The run must use live architecture providers.
The run must be operable through the repository-scoped Desktop skills.
The run uses only an evidence-backed Godot tuple.
The run must emit the compact human report.
The completed run must use the two-phase evidence seal.

verificationMethod: Start from a clean separate Godot fixture and run every applicable lifecycle operation and Gate through ChatGPT Desktop on Windows, then replay checkpoints, query traceability, verify the build, and validate both Git seals.
successCriteria: A user can deterministically produce and accept a working Godot change end to end with live-provider receipts, complete traceability, structured evidence, and no unsupported release claim.
